classification.theory_summary: Speculates about connections between waking world and “Mall World,” describing both as illusory realms and discussing currency, escapism, and creative/spiritual themes; includes a few example-like vignettes (flight, game-show groceries, toilet cart) but not framed as a specific dream report.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete, bounded dream episode with describable locations/connections/events; content is primarily speculative/theoretical with rhetorical questions and hypothetical examples.

meta.author_theory: Mall World and the waking world are both “illusions/realms,” possibly closely connected (“veil thin”); Mall World is something people may flee to while this world is something people run from; questions about how payment/currency works in Mall World and contrasts with stressful currency in waking life.

extraction.extraction_notes: Text contains general claims and rhetorical/hypothetical scenarios (e.g., “Superman flight,” “getting groceries game show style,” “ride a toilet cart…”) but they are not presented as a specific dream scene with stable setting details (lighting, layout, sequence, entities). Therefore no location/connection extraction was performed.
